Name: Radio Announcer
Dialog: It's another gorgeous summer day here in the Tri-State Area. Ladies, have you asked a date to the Night of the Falling Stars Girls-Choice Dance yet? It seems Danville's gone star-crazy waiting for the meteor shower tonight!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A meteor shower? How cool is that? Just think

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hey, boys? Boys? Oh there you are! Hey, look what I got for you online!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, cool! You named a star after us!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You're now the owners of a little piece of the universe!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you get one for Candace too?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I did. Yes, of course I did, although she doesn't really care about this stuff. Anyway, they're practically giving 'em away online! D'you know, it's even better than the Oklahoma land rush of 1889!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ah, those corny history references made me fall for him in the first place. Vivian and I are off to our mahjong tournament. Have fun today, boys.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, darling. Good luck.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good luck!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, what am I doing standing here when I can be out buying more stars?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Now that we own a star, we should go check it out! And how cool is space travel? The g-forces, eating dinner out of a tube, going to the bathroom without going to the bathroom, not to mention the weightlessness. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Jeremy, I was wondering, uh... if you'd like to go the Night of the Falling Stars Girls-Choice Dance with me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: With you? You've got to be kidding me. (He begins laughing)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking on the phone) And that, Stacy, is why I can't ask Jeremy to the dance.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You realize that's kind of a worse-case scenario, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That could very well happen. What if he says no? What if he laughs in my face?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You can't let fear rule your life, Candace. Jeremy likes you. He's not gonna say no. Now, I'm gonna hang up, and when I do, I want you to call Jeremy. Don't man the phone, girl. Phone the man!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I am not gonna let fear rule my life. (Dials number)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Muffled) Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy? Yeah, I can't do it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And this is Mission Control.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Kinda small.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, it looks small on the outside. But Ferb really knows how to maximize space.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, can I ask you something? Will you go to the dance-

Name: Katie
Dialog: Excuse me Phineas, can I get you to sign some liability waivers?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure thing. (To Isabella) Hold that thought, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure. No prob.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why are you guys walking so slow?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dramatic effect.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You guys ready?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (From inside the rocket) The star coordinates are pre-programmed. Let's light this candle.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All systems go. Commence countdown.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (In a deep voice) Ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, (A bird crashes into rocket) two, one. (She clears throat, then peaks in her normal voice) Ignition.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like we need a Jump-start.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, what if while I'm asking him, a satellite falls out of orbit and crashes into the— Wait a minute, what is going on out there? I'll call you back, Stacy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Positive to positive, negative to ground, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Climbing into Phineas and Ferb's spaceship) Brothers. Does every sister have to deal with this? No. Do I have to deal with this? Of course. You'd think I'd have better things to do and other things to worry about. Every single day, it's one thing after another. But do Mom and Dad see it? No. Do they get in trouble? No. And another thing– (She enters the cockpit, to find Phineas and Ferb aren't there)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Got the remote?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, guys? I think you should see this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? How'd you get in there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Yelling) I can't hear you! My cheeks are covering my ears!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We should probably help her. Good thing we built two rockets.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, it's pretty.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was for Candace to see her star. I don't know why she took ours.

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: (In a space shuttle, preparing to dock with the space station) Uh, ready to park this puppy?

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: Oh, it's bad enough this happens on earth. Now space?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're coming to get you, Candace! Hey, she's coming in! (Speaking to candace over video phone) Candace, don't worry. It's pre-programmed. As long as you don't start hitting buttons randomly, everything will be okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't hear you! I'm too busy hitting buttons randomly!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By the way, Candace, where's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know. He must've gotten off before we launched.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, afraid I have terrible news. It's Doofenshmirtz. He's built a space station, and due to budget cuts, we have no way of getting you into space. Now, I've contacted the president, and... Agent P, are you in space? Nice work. You are always one step ahead. Your mission is to find Doofenshmirtz and stop him, Agent P.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: (Floating in space) Agent P? Agent P?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, guys, what are all these red flashing things heading toward my rocket?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, those are asteroids.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Asteroids? (She screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just like Beggar's Canyon back home. We're catching up to her!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oop, she lost her engines. Let's go get her.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't believe it's Perry the Platypus. (He traps Perry in an ice cube tray) Hohohohoho Perry the Platypus, what are you doing here? I thought you guys were having budget cuts. Well, it just shows to go ya. Hey, let's walk and talk. So, you're probably wondering why my space station has two enormous arms. Well, what you should be wondering is why it has two giant hands! Ha ha ha ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Flashing back) See, during my teen years, I was very adept at hand shadows. It was great for entertaining at parties, and for meeting Fräuleins. But then one day, there was a new puppeteer in town. His name was Hans, and his hands were huge. We called him "Huge Hands Hans". His puppetry was garbage, but unfortunately, it was good enough for my Fräulein. I lost her to a boy with bigger fingers, and I never did a shadow puppet again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Until tonight! (He laughs) And when the sun rises in one hour; see, right over there; Then everyone in the Tri-State Area will see my enormous hand shadows on the moon!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There she is! Uh-oh, this isn't good. Candace, you're in a decaying orbit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What does that even mean?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You just need to get to the spacesuit on the hook behind you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now put it on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'm putting it on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now walk over to the door.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'm at the door.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now just open it and take a little spacewalk to our ship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, there's nothing to be scared of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nothing to be scared of? There's the never-ending, icy-cold, soul-sucking darkness of space!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I hear negative!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There is no way I'm going out there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're just a few yards away. You can't let fear rule your life.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course I can. That's my thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, just calm down and take Ferb's hand.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb's hand? (Ferb grabs her hand, and leaves Candace's ship, dragging Candace along, back to Phineas's ship) Thanks, guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mission Control? Come in, Mission Control.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, did you find Candace?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. We've got her, and we're on our way home.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Excellent. So, Phineas, speaking of home, there's that dance tonight, and– (An alarm begins beeping)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hold that thought, Isabella. I think we're out of fuel.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Find some fuel somewhere and let's go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's gonna be hard. We're kinda nowhere.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean we're stuck here in the empty void of space?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas... what is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have no idea.

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: Uh, will the owner of a red station wagon please move your vehicle? You are in a shuttle loading and unloading zone only.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have no idea. (reading the signs that was emitting the light) Milk shakes? Wow, that was so bright, I thought it was a star. Maybe we'll find some fuel here. (The rocket lands) Are you sure you don't wanna come with us? Ferb says the oxygen levels are just like Earth.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh... I'm sure. Just find some fuel, and let's get out of here!

Name: Bartender
Dialog: One sarsaparilla coming up.

Name: Alien
Dialog: I love you, man.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi. I'm Phineas, and this is Ferb.

Name: Bartender
Dialog: Wait a second. You're Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Bartender
Dialog: Hey, everyone, it's the new owners!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: New owners? Those coordinates are right here. Ferb, this is our star. Wow. That sign really is bright.

Name: Alien 2
Dialog: I told you they'd show up.

Name: Bartender
Dialog: So now that you own the joint, what do you think of it? I know, it's a little run-down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have a few ideas for this place.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You do realize that's a worst-case scenario, right, Candace? But I do feel for ya. I've been trying to ask Phineas to that same dance all–

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas. What's taking those boys so long? They were supposed to find fuel ages ago. Later, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure. No prob.

Name: Doorman
Dialog: (In a Cockney accent) Stop right there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me in, buster.

Name: Doorman
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb don't take kindly to gatecrashers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm no gatecrasher; I'm their sister!

Name: Doorman
Dialog: Ooh, sorry about that. Honest mistake. You won't mention this to them, eh?

Name: Alien 3
Dialog: Uh, I'm their sister.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, guess what? This is our star!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I thought we were getting out of here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I thought we'd fix up the place. You know, pride of ownership? Take a load off. Have a shake.

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: I can't do it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, are you okay?

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: No. The bicentennial Taming of the Yarks Dance is tonight, and I wanna ask the girl of my dreams, but what if she says no? What if she laughs in my face? What if her friends laugh at me? What if her friends' friends laugh at me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aren't you being a little overly dramatic? I mean, really, what's the worst thing that could happen?

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: Uh... the entire planet could blow up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Please. I think you should just ask her to the dance.

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: Really? You think so?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I do. Really.

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: Well... Okay. (He takes a breath) Here goes nothin'. Ahem. Sylvia... will you go to the dance with me?

Name: Sylvia
Dialog: (Appearing, attached to his head) Well, of course. I've been waiting for you to ask me. I mean, even if you asked someone else, I'd still have to go with you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? That wasn't so hard.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So... Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I get it. Big lesson. Yeah, well, I learned that it wouldn't be hard to ask Jeremy out if he was growing out of the back of my head. Now you find us some fuel, and let's get outta here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. I just wanted to know if she liked the shake. (to the bartender) You don't know where we could find some rocket fuel, do ya?

Name: Bartender
Dialog: Rocket fuel? It's all Ronaldo drinks.

Name: Ronaldo
Dialog: (In an Italian accent) Only imported rocket fuel.

Name: Ronaldo
Dialog: Grazie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, I'm sensing Candace wants to leave.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Will you cut that out?

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: Okay, that's it. I'm not waiting anymore. (The two astronauts lift the car away) Great. Let's park the shuttle. (A flying saucer lands) Oh, come on! (He throws his helmet off in fury, and quickly puffs up because of it) Uh-oh. I think I should go inside now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why are we stopping?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it. We have plenty of fuel. The battery's worn down. Candace, were you using the videophone without the engine running?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Was that a bad thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If by "bad", you mean we're stranded in the never-ending, icy-cold, soul-sucking darkness of space... then, yeah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon, Perry the Platypus, the sun will be at full strength, and my plan will come to fruition. Unless, of course, it's overcast... (An alarm begins beeping) Eh, but what are you going to do? Proximity alert? Why are there so many people in space? What's up with that?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You need another jump-start? Candace, didn't you have the engine running when we were talking on the videophone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Am I the only person who doesn't know this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, any suggestions, Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sensors are indicating a massive power source in your area.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Where? I don't see it. (Doofenshmirtz's ship rises behind Phineas, Ferb, and Candace's) Wait a minute. I see it. It's Mom's car! We're saved! Ferb, toss me the starter remote. (Ferb shrugs) Ooh, that's right. We left it at home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's a starter remote?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, legally we're too young to start a car. We get away with it by using a starter remote. But you, Candace, have your learner's permit. Looks like you'll be doing the jump-starting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Oh, no, no, no, no, no. Can't you guys just find some old nuts and bolts lying around and jerry-rig up some kind of machiney-deely-bob and get us out of this situation?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Candace, we are just kids.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ( She groans) Why am I arguing this? Hand me the suit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let me turn on the oxygen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Does this suit make my butt look big?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it does. Maybe I had the pressure up too high.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Never mind. I'll fix it. (She backs up, and transfers the inflation to her hands) Well, I guess this is preferable.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can do this, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can't do this. I can't do this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Watching) What is this? Now, why would an astronaut wear such big gloves? Wait a second! (He gasps) Huge Hands Hans?! It's Huge Hands Hans! He found me out in space! Oh, you're not going to steal a job from me this time, Huge Hands Hans! Nor my Fräuleins!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How did it go again, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's positive to positive.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Positive to positive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Negative to ground.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What ground? We're in space!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, no. Ground just means any piece of metal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Any piece of metal? Well, then why do they call it ground? Why don't they just call it me- (She turns around and sees Doofenshimrtz's spaceship reaching to grab her)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's wrong, Candace? Candace? Candace, what's wro- (Phineas sees the ship as well) Oh. Danville, we have a problem.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls, turn to the giant robot section of your Fireside Girls manuals.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, anything?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Still looking.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Here it is. Okay. According to this, you should get the heck out of there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great, but we've got no power. She didn't connect the— Candace, negative to ground!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Negative to ground, Candace! Negative to ground!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you mean negative to metal! (She attaches the jump lead to the robot, thereby giving the rocket a jumpstart) I did it! I did it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She did it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Huge Hands Hans is getting away! Not this time, freak fingers!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz chases after them) Just you wait, Huge Hands Hans! You can run, but you can't hide! You know, he can run, but he can't– (Perry's ice tray smacks Doofenshmirtz across the face) Ow! Wait a second. How did you--? Oh, I see. That's it— (Perry, with the remote control launches back at Doofenshmirtz) That's not fair! Oh, that's it, It's on now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, I hate to bother you again.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no bother.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You got anything else? The robot's gaining on us.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It says they don't corner well.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They don't corner well? Wait a sec. Candace, fasten your seat belt. We're taking a little detour. (They steer the spaceship into the asteroid belt, swing Candace around) Now, how is she passing us?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, what are you doing?! (She screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See? Corners like a dream.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it! Run away, Perry the Scaredy– Oof. (With his face puffed up from exposure to the vacuum of space) Oh, I think I need to put on my spacesuit. Uh oh.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And now, my good man, you ready for this? Your tip. Your very own star.

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: Uptown, they give quasars. (He drives off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sweet land!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas, you guys were great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks. You weren't too bad yourself.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh. (She giggles) Thanks. So, would you like to go to the Night of the Falling Stars Girls' Choice Dance tonight?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like fun.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, what's our schedule like?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, we'll be there.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Both of you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. Why don't you come by, and we'll all walk over together?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure. No prob.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks for the lift, Viv.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Stares at her rocket ship and walks up to Linda) Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, sweetheart. Oh, look at your outfit. Hey, guess what? We won! (flatly) But the grand prize was a star.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (eating pizza) Ooh, whoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smiles) Mom, that's great, but you gotta see something in the yard. Come on, you gotta see it! Come on, come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right, I'm a-comin'.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. Uh, I'll be right with you after I pull my car into the garage.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, it's still here! (to Linda) See, Mom? There! Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm just backing the car in! I'll be right with you!

Name: Linda
Dialog: So what did you want to show me, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (facepalms) Just go make some pie...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Or... (leaving) How about a healthy fruit salad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, curse this tin can! Ugh, I'm going to need a jump-start! (Phineas and Ferb;s rocket crashes into Doofenshmirtz's, causing it to begin to fall towards earth) I, uh, no, I guess it won't help now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I just wanted to say thank you. We were in a pretty precarious situation up there. If it wasn't for your bravery, who knows what would have happened?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? You think I'm... brave?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you kidding? Ferb was goin' on and on about it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I was brave! (She gasps) I was brave! I'm not gonna let fear rule my life anymore! Now I've gotta go. I've got a mission to accomplish.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Perry. Where ya been?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, will you go to the dance with me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Reveals she's in her spacesuit) Yeah.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I've been waiting for you to ask me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. Only, uh, uh, Candace, is that what you're gonna wear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why? You like it?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, look.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A shooting star, just for us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Screaming) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! And you too, Huge Hands Hans!

Name: Voice
Dialog: It's the final frontier, baby.
